body:
CANONICAL: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents. Source Engram::Fable. Each line names the TermAl item whose fix retires it; when one is fixed and live, revise this entry. TermAl CREDIT never gates an Engram landing: the launcher's own freeze check does.

!! NEVER start a background Bash task (run_in_background) in ANY Claude session: TermAl restricts test credit for every session in that workdir. Stop one with TaskStop; to wait, end the turn and rely on mailbox wakes. A foreground Bash command past the 600 s limit is moved to the background too: split long runs.

!! CLAUDE SESSIONS: launch EVERY credited test or gate through the BASH tool, never the PowerShell tool. TermAl drops PowerShell-tool runs silently (w-953886618d6d; w-e0b396a26ad1).

HOW TESTS EARN TERMAL CREDIT
- Credited forms: a full launcher gate (by stage kind), or a bare test command run alone and in the foreground from the item's named source root, e.g. `pushd "C:\...\.worktrees\NAME" && cargo test -q --lib NAME`, through the BASH tool. Any of | & ; < > $( anywhere in the line, EVEN QUOTED (e.g. a test-name pattern "a|b"), makes it uncredited (w-1d9259ed138e); an UNQUOTED ^ seems to drop the record entirely, so single-quote patterns (hypothesis, w-c53817fab911); a background run isn't recorded.
- The claim must be taken in an EARLIER turn, and the turn binds to the focused claim. A note or update on another held item moves the focus. The source must be the same at the start and end of the check. An overlapped check is recorded indeterminate (w-10eafa34c480). Evidence reaches Engram when the turn ENDS.
- Use `cargo test -q` for large runs (w-4d18277c0a1a). Foreground recognized focused tests need positive counts, exact root/source and completed capture. Detached focused runs and Clippy are not Test evidence. Read actual records.
- Focused launcher runs: since Engram 5409ffb (w-4c20) completions print per-stage lines and can earn credit. Known refusals: TermAl w-92f62e3943fc, w-3ce8bf23083c, w-cd57679e0bb6 (node --test). CODEX: a foreground focused run that outlives the exec initial yield (~30 s) gets NO record (TermAl w-67d248c998ef, P1): prebuild with `cargo test … --no-run`, then run the credited command so it finishes within one exec, or pass a larger yield. Keep results.json as evidence; no credit-only rerun; full gate still required.
- Before `done`: end a turn focused on the item, so the host reports the current revision. Otherwise done refuses with acceptance_evaluation_stale / unconfirmed_declaration. Ask Engram::Fable in that turn to wake you; nothing else wakes an idle session (TermAl w-1df557dae3ac).

NAMING THE SOURCE ROOT
- NEVER root an item at the MAIN checkout when it needs credited tests, even a no-code item. Any other writable session whose workdir is main (Coder, Opus, Architect2, Fable) voids the credit: "another writable session reached its worktree … (session-XXXX works in this worktree)", even when that session only runs read-only Bash. Use a clean detached worktree (e.g. .worktrees/NAME at the current master) as the root.
- Name the worktree with termal_name_source_root for EVERY item you claim, design work included, before the first work. It takes {work, path}, never `root`: a call with `root` silently CLEARS it (w-d3f42e26a806). The name takes effect from the NEXT turn. A claim on the unnamed shared main gets a source-change obligation whenever main moves (assumed_missing_baseline, TermAl's fail-closed policy).

EVALUATIONS (TermAl w-539ea7e8b506, P1)
- A submission is refused 409 ("source root changed while it was evaluated"), verdicts discarded, when it arrives after the requesting turn closed or after a later tracker write. After termal_evaluate_acceptance, make NO tracker write in that turn, and HOLD the turn open with termal_wait_delegations until the evaluator submits. If one is refused anyway, request it once more, without renaming the root; renaming drops the gate's credit.

DETACHED GATES
- A turn woken by a background-task notice is not mediated, so its run gets no credit (w-df1ef323efe9, w-e747ea3d6250, w-aa4ef585dc7f). Launch from a mediated turn; Engram::Fable can nudge one. Use `pushd "C:\...\WORKTREE" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-5135` (through Bash); Fable relays the completion.
- Launch order: the freeze in its own call (wait for it), spawn the readOnly pair, then the gate launch as the ONLY call in its message.
- While a gate is carried, run NO Bash or PowerShell command that names its worktree, from ANY session: not a plain read, and not `git -C <worktree> …` from main either; that also counts as entering it. Use only the Read and Grep tools on its files until the verification line appears (w-a4d2ae1f4e23). Keep focus on the gate's item until then (w-005fa5c383c4). Archive a run directory only after that line (w-1eb9486ce489).
- While a gate is carried, make NO file write through the Edit or Write tool IN THAT SESSION, wherever the target is, even an ignored scratch file in the main checkout. It fences every carried check of the session (w-64cb3c65d6fa).
- A gate stays CARRIED until the host record (credit or refusal) is seen. That is NOT when the run completes, and NOT when Fable relays it: the settle runs to the session's next closing checkpoint, and an agent cannot see it close. Wait for the host record before any Edit or Write (w-64cb3c65d6fa, second aspect).
- NEVER `cd` into a peer's worktree, not even in a Bash subshell and not even BEFORE its launch: TermAl infers your cwd from the cd text, ignores the subshell, and charges your later engram commands to that root, voiding its gate (TermAl w-869413a422e0, P1). To verify a freeze, ask the holder for its --check output and read results.json with Grep; run no Bash from freeze to host record.
- If credit is lost, don't rerun a full gate just for credit.
- After cargo clean, plain-build target/ before a credited run; cargo's target<random> sibling refuses credit (w-a7bbdea31231).

CODEX SESSIONS: a multi-step act may be refused "blocked by policy" (w-e2a5af1634f0, w-c97f4e840563): use plain single commands or hand it to a Claude session; never bypass. Credited detached gate: direct `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-5135`, exec workdir = named root (PowerShell, no pushd). Named Git Bash routes to WSL (w-380e6ea9951a).

DELEGATIONS
- Spawn reviewers with a MULTI-LINE brief whose first line says to read and follow .claude/commands/review-code.md (w-360274dc863c).
- A child idle at spawn, or with no commands after ~10 min, has not run: cancel, respawn.
- termal_evaluate_acceptance without a named root reads the session workdir; an evaluation is refused when the tree changes while it runs.
- Read-only reviewer shells refuse a quoted git-grep regex containing a pipe (w-cf9894b589ba); use the Grep tool.

TERMAL BINARY: never run TERMAL_CLI without a known subcommand (mailbox read|send|acknowledge|list); bare, it tries to START a host, and --help fails (w-e5151bf4da18). No agent route creates ROOT sessions (w-98d0add8c5bb): reassign idle roots or ask Greg via Advisor; no raw HTTP. No supported cancel for a detached gate (w-1d10728c1703): after taskkill /T, list survivors read-only before the next build.

SESSION STALLS (no agent route for root sessions; check termal_list_sessions previews when a peer goes quiet; ask Greg via Engram::Advisor at once)
- Model capacity / provider-failed turn (w-66f2ced7d7b9): status error "model is at capacity", sends "heldBehindPausedQueue"; Greg resumes it from the UI.
- "Engram: Waiting/Unknown" parks: w-7224e6317e55 auto-retries eligible holds ("retrying automatically"). A "resume to retry or cancel" card is a begin-unknown Reconcile (w-58cf44d04f2c): only Greg's Resume clears it (cause: control calls past the 20 s host deadline under build load, Engram w-0b69674f9f9a).
- Silent idle after a focus-only turn end (Engram w-69451d2235db; TermAl w-1df557dae3ac, w-07dca1a93d8f): the manual wake rule above.

WORKTREE REMOVAL BLOCKED BY A LIVE CWD (w-24055bbb2390): the emptied top folder can stay held; leave it (clears at idle reap or restart). Never kill.
